text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Admirable!
Thank you all for your passionate training today!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, here you go!
A little snack from me to you!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Chairwoman Akikawa had handed over
looked exceedingly high-class at a glance—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A super delicious ice cream
assortment box!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
For all of you running around in this scorching heat,
I want to relieve your daily fatigue even just a little!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...And keep this strictly between us,
don't let Tazuna find out! That's an absolute order!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Well then... I shall take my leave!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The super delicious ice cream was, quite literally, melt-in-your-mouth delicious.
